current_definitions.SOS: close > previous 24-bar high AND volume >= 1.20 × 20-bar volume average
current_definitions.TEST: after any prior Spring: low stays within 20% of current range width above Spring low, volume <= 70% of Spring volume, close in upper half

conclusion: Current SOS does not require a flat accumulation range, a close near the high, or a minimum spread/effort confirmation.
Current Test state never expires after Spring, so a later low-volume bar can be called a Test long after the original Spring.
